pres.diff.label: What makes us different
pres.diff.title: Talenco is not a directory. It's a filter.
pres.diff.c1.title: Verified candidates
pres.diff.c1.desc: Every CV is reviewed by a human before appearing in the database. Recruiters only see real, consistent, active profiles.
pres.diff.c2.title: Certified companies
pres.diff.c2.desc: RCCM, IFU, interview with the Talenco team. No company can post jobs without being verified. Zero scams, zero fake recruitment.
pres.diff.c3.title: AI grounded in local context
pres.diff.c3.desc: Matching and coaching are calibrated for the Beninese market — sectors, company cultures, compensation levels. Not an American model badly translated.
